EXAM TRAP   RAID is not a backup
Mirroring and RAID give resilience against hardware failure. They do not protect against deletion, corruption or encryption, because whatever happens to the original happens immediately to the copy. A question offering RAID as the answer to data loss is offering the wrong answer.

WORKED EXAMPLE   The pattern behind the example
Field, format and range checks catch data that is the wrong shape.
Validity checks catch codes that do not exist.
Record counts and financial totals catch things missing or added.
Only a hash total or closed-loop verification catches one valid code substituted for another.

EXAM TRAP   Exam view
Ask what kind of error it is before choosing a control. Wrong shape, absent code, wrong count, or one valid value swapped for another. The last of these is the one most candidates get wrong, and it has only two answers.
